adaptive_gate_definition.age: decision_slot - last_actual_cache_row_change_slot; initial row change origin is Slot 0
adaptive_gate_definition.all_zero_or_tie: Median is 0 when all valid shifts are 0; strict greater-than means no early release.
adaptive_gate_definition.cache_row_change: Only an actual changed cache row resets that node age and stores the current decision-time forecast distribution as the new anchor.
adaptive_gate_definition.decision: Age <5 forces KEEP. Age 5-9 allows the frozen Actor action only when node TV change is strictly above the current nine-node median. Age >=10 restores the frozen Actor action. An allowed UPDATE is not forced.
adaptive_gate_definition.distance_metric: 0.5 * L1 total variation over the normalized per-node service distribution plus a no-forecast-mass category.
adaptive_gate_definition.forecast_alignment: At decision slot t, use valid GRU-derived prediction scenarios aligned to target slots t through t+4 (or the valid-mask subset at episode boundary). Anchor the same five-slot-ahead distribution when a row actually changes.
adaptive_gate_definition.global_holding: Not directly modified except the separate GLOBAL_HOLDING_5 reference branch; no macro boundaries are added.
adaptive_gate_definition.initialization: At Slot 0 anchor each node to its current valid forecast distribution and start age at 0.
adaptive_gate_definition.node_service_demand: Use existing prediction-scenario arrivals/service IDs averaged over forecast scenarios with the configured cache horizon discount; weight each predicted vehicle/horizon by its full-bandwidth physical uplink rate share across the nine Edge nodes using the formal channel/rate functions, without a new hard range threshold.
adaptive_gate_definition.nonfinite: Exclude invalid node variation from peer median and fail closed to KEEP during ages 5-9; formal aligned inputs or physical rates that are themselves invalid stop the affected run rather than being imputed.
adaptive_gate_definition.threshold: Median of the nine finite node variation values at the current Macro decision; strict greater-than releases early; ties do not release.
adaptive_gate_definition.zero_demand: Represent no forecast mass as a dedicated atom; zero-to-zero has variation 0 and zero-to-nonzero has variation 1.

episode_selection.selection_rule: Sort the existing Training episode IDs, remove the listed exclusions, then select indices round(k*(N-1)/7), k=0..7, using Python round-to-even; freeze this list before any policy-return run.

execution.wall_seconds_scope: sum of final analyzed rollout-loop runtimes plus the discarded first GLOBAL_HOLDING_5 rollout-loop runtimes; excludes environment loading and summary finalization
execution.discarded_global_holding_initial_run_not: The initial 16 Global-Holding branches were invalid because learned termination could end a Macro before slot 5. They were discarded and rerun with policy termination suppressed until exactly 5 elapsed slots.

interpretation_criteria.adaptive_node_control_promising: Require positive mean 60-slot paired Delta Return and at least 5/8 positive Episode differences against each of ROW_MIN_10 and GLOBAL_HOLDING_5, plus evidence that the 5-9 slot gate both forces KEEP and allows early release. This is a practical diagnostic bar, not a statistical significance test.
interpretation_criteria.learnable_residence_policy_recommendatio: Do not recommend a trainable PPO residence policy unless the adaptive gate is state-dependent and meets the above paired-return bar; otherwise keep the result descriptive and request further preregistered Training evidence.
